reasons.claim: 0.78 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified. A 2015 completed felling overlaps 25.2% of the polygon (0.197 ha), below the 50% threshold for ALREADY_FELLED.

One eligible species is recorded within 250 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (VU, lichen, site-bound, forest-associated; threats include lack of continuity forest and lack of large or old trees). The record is 62 m from the polygon edge (2026, unc 25 m). This gives HIGH under the rubric.
Supporting NT site-bound records within 261 m: Cystostereum murrayi (197 m, 2026) and Bryoria nadvornikiana (261 m, 2026). Fewer than 3 are within 250 m, so they do not trigger a separate rule.
Effort is low: 8 records within 1000 m (14th percentile; county median 66). Near-site there are 0 records inside and 2 within 250 m (county median 3).

contradictions.claim: The 2015 completed felling overlaps part of the polygon, yet the 2026 lichen record lies 62 m away. Whether the remaining stand is relevant to that record is unclear.

uncertainties: The record is outside the polygon (62 m), so presence on the stand itself is not shown. Its 25 m uncertainty is small relative to the 50 m site radius, though not negligible.
Effort is low, so the records likely under-represent what is present.
The overlap with the 2015 felling is from satellite change detection and covers 25% of the polygon; the state of the rest of the stand is not described by the tools.
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the polygon.
Habitat quality or age of the remaining stand.
Legality of the felling or any causal effect on the species recorded.
next_action: Send for human ecological review before the felling start date. Check the stand edge and the area around the 2026 Alectoria sarmentosa record, and consider the nearby 2026 NT records. Take the 2015 partial felling into account.
